notes: One handwritten note sheet on a printed INSTITUT / DES HAUTES ÉTUDES SCIENTIFIQUES letterhead. Three entries are headed by SGA 5 and barred XIII, barred IV, and barred XIV. The first asks for comments on the crystalline case and congruence formulae mod p; the second directs attention to the relative case and consultation of VII and SGA 6 X; the third asks for variants and refers to a note or notes about th. de Katz. There is one cancelled unreadable word, one three-line grouping bracket, and the printed letterhead rule. The lower heading and paragraph are lighter than the upper writing. Authorship is not independently established from this packet, so the inventory uses unnamed hand. No date, author page number, marginal insertion, or explicit author doubt mark is visible. Archive 52 appears at lower left and is recorded only in a comment; H’s page wrapper is treated as metadata, not as a distinct substantive transcription. Editorial uncertainties remain in the two Commentaires endings, the accent of Problèmes, the cancelled word, and the final une/mes and note/notes. c_doubt also marks explicit glyph checks supplied in C_context.md even where C.tex used no unsure macro. No theorem or proof was checked.

The page gives editorial directions concerning the crystalline and relative cases, not a displayed mathematical argument. Its allusion th. de Katz is preserved without determining or expanding the abbreviation.
